brief: Identifier for an MCP protocol session, when the operation belongs to a session.

changelog.description: Clarified that the identifier requires a real MCP protocol session
Set is_in_otel=true, attribute exists in OTel MCP registry

additional_context: Applies to protocol versions and transports that provide MCP session management, including legacy Streamable HTTP sessions. Omit for operations without a protocol session; do not synthesize a session identifier from a request, connection, or conversation.
